about_the_game:
Mathew’s love life is a disaster.

No matter how hard he tries, he just can’t win over a girl—not even his childhood friend, Masha. Frustrated, he takes matters into his own hands, building an advanced android designed to be his perfect match.

But when he runs the final script, something goes wrong… Instead of a dream girl, he gets a flawless male android—a mirror image of himself in both looks and personality. Now, Mathew must deal with the unexpected consequences of his own creation.

Key Features:

  • Engaging Narrative: A humorous and thought-provoking visual novel with 3 different ends influenced by your choices.

  • Dynamic Characters: Explore Mathew’s struggles, Masha’s perspective, and his android counterpart.

  • Unexpected Twists: A unique take on love, identity, and self-discovery.

  • Short and Sweet Gameplay: A 30-60 minute story-driven experience.

When science meets romance, expect the unexpected. Are you ready to reboot your heart?

But when the final script malfunctions, he ends up with a flawless male version of himself instead. Now, he must deal with the unexpected consequences of his own creation. Love just got complicated.
